description: Pre-READY submission-risk patterns (ADVISORY-ONLY). Flags findings likely to be rejected by a bounty on axes OTHER than PoC validity. Seeded from the first real-world adjudicated outcomes (2026-06): the PoCs were valid; rejections clustered on deployment-reachability, duplicate/novelty, and design-accepted/known-pattern. Consumed read-only by scripts/submission_risk_audit.py. NEVER a gate; NEVER auto-rejects; NEVER written to rejection_rules.jsonl. Human-editable.
_honesty_note: These are HEURISTIC text-signal matches over the finding's title/description/recommendation. A match is a PROMPT TO VERIFY before submitting, not a verdict. Deployment-reachability mostly cannot be decided from finding text alone -> the scorer emits checklist_required rather than a confident score. design_acceptance matches carry the real-outcome provenance that motivated them.

design_acceptance.name: NAV / oracle settlement tolerance (design-level)
design_acceptance.outcome_provenance: solvbtc-solana (HackenProof 2026-06-15: known design characteristic; program excludes design-level NAV/oracle settlement)
design_acceptance.rationale: NAV/oracle settlement tolerance is frequently a documented design property and program-excluded; confirm the program does not exclude design-level NAV/settlement before submitting.

design_acceptance.name: reward/principal fund commingling, no reserve (known pattern)
design_acceptance.outcome_provenance: idos-nodestaking (HackenProof 2026-06-13: matches a prior submission assessed out of scope)
design_acceptance.rationale: Reward/principal commingling with no on-chain reserve is a recurring staking pattern often ruled out-of-scope or duplicate; check for a prior submission and the program's scope rules.

design_acceptance.name: third-party adaptor stale accumulator / unsettled yield
design_acceptance.outcome_provenance: volo (HackenProof 2026-06-16: third-party adaptor, no direct fund loss, known pattern -> Not applicable)
design_acceptance.rationale: Mis-valuation from an unsettled third-party-integration accumulator is often rated not-applicable (no direct loss / third-party) or a known pattern; confirm a direct, in-scope fund-loss path.

deployment_reachability_signals._note: Light signals that the vulnerable path may NOT be wired in the live deployment. A hit lowers confidence but does NOT decide; absence of a hit yields checklist_required (the wiring cannot be known from finding text).

novelty_signals._note: Used only when output/kb_crossref.md (KB/solodit similarity) is present. High similarity to a known public finding => likely duplicate/known. Absent KB => checklist_required.
